description: Road Deaths Australia—Monthly Bulletins is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Road Safety Data. Latest summaries of road crash deaths and fatal road crashes are presented here. Updates are monthly and published on or around the 14th of each month. Data are sourced from the road traffic or police authorities in each jurisdiction. Data are preliminary and subject to revision. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Road Safety Data. Its tags are National, Road, Road Users, Safety. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
